ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1:12 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-density clusters of small, circular white blobs are mapped across the entire surface, with increased concentration on the distal lateral regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree angle and a bounding box depth representing roughly 15% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (3-12 pixels) along the entire trailing edge, with prominent irregular jagged peaks at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bilateral convex curves extending from the median notch to the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Globally distributed white pixel clusters (2-8 pixels diameter) consistent with barnacle scar patterns, most visible against the dark fluke background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular, jagged white-toned erosion/serration pattern at the tip of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: A distinct vertical white linear feature located on the right lobe, approximately 3/4 distance from the notch to the tip.
